ui_derived.label: Speed
ui_derived.rule: UI-only multiplier: multiplies every steps[].seconds by the factor and writes those values (each clamped to 0.15-3). The factor itself is never stored. Rev 23: it also scales start_at_ms, hold_ms, fade_out_ms, particle_life_ms and flash_ms (§2.10.1.3 rule 3a) and blank_ms, shine_ms and shine_loop_rest_ms (§2.10.2.4, §2.10.2.8), each clamped to its range. It never scales hit_stop_ms.

ui_derived.label: Count
ui_derived.rule: Edits row_count or orbit_count on the first step whose kind is row or orbit; disabled with a hint when there is none. Rev 23: it also scales particle_count on the particles steps, capped at 48 (§2.10.1.3 rule 3a).

ui_derived.label: Dim the stage
ui_derived.rule: Maps to steps.enabled of the dim steps. Turning it on with no dim step inserts one at its defaults with start_mode at-time (§2.10.1.3 rule 3a, L46).

ui_derived.label: Flash
ui_derived.rule: Maps to steps.enabled of the flash steps whose flash_strength is above 0 (§2.10.1.3 rule 3a, L46).

ui_derived.label: Impact flash
ui_derived.rule: On when the effect has an enabled at-hit white circle flash with offset 0 followed in list order by an at-hit black circle flash; turning it on writes the two §2.10.2.2 steps (and pins connect_step first, §2.10.2.1); off sets enabled false on that pair (L47).

ui_derived.label: Shockwave
ui_derived.rule: On when the effect has an enabled at-hit ring-only flash step (flash_strength 0) on ground; off sets enabled false (§2.10.2.3, L47).

ui_derived.label: Blank punch
ui_derived.rule: On when any enabled step has blank_ms above 0; off writes 0 or enabled false (§2.10.2.12, L47).

ui_derived.label: Hit-stop
ui_derived.rule: On when hit_stop_ms is above 0; the toggle writes 50, off writes 0 (§2.10.2.5, §2.10.2.12, L47).

ui_derived.label: Smear
ui_derived.rule: On when smear_ms is above 0; the toggle writes 40, off writes 0 (§2.10.2.6, L47).

ui_derived.label: Hit-white
ui_derived.rule: On when hit_white_ms is above 0; the toggle writes 40, off writes 0 (§2.10.2.7, L47).

ui_derived.label: Shine
ui_derived.rule: On when shine_ms is above 0; the toggle writes 320, off writes 0 (§2.10.2.8, L47).

behaviours.name: Terrain (what each tile id means)
behaviours.summary: The single home for tile meanings: for each logic tile id, whether units can stand, land or spawn there, whether landing kills, whether a push can enter, and whether it slows or trips. Edge walls (earth lines) are not tiles in the code: they sit on a tile's n/e/s/w edge and live in Barrier Line. Walls on tile edges (the map's logic.edges) always block movement and adjacency across that edge: that is core grid behaviour with no knob. The two wall knobs only decide whether walls also block line of sight and shots.

knobs.description: Built-ins water, lava and wall-block are CONFIRMED engine defaults (Engine Architect 2026-11-09, L27) and the defaultTileType targets of the procedural recipes (project-format r13 section 6.2.2 / 6.4): water@2 and murk@1 give water, lava@2 gives lava, wall gives wall-block, ice@1 gives floor in v1 (slippery ice is a future tile type), the rest give floor. buildable (item field, rev 15, PROPOSED, modes: td; v1: false): whether a structure may be placed on the tile. False on every built-in, floor included: grid tactics has no building and BTF never places structures, so false keeps tactics unchanged; a TD project sets it on its own tile types (Engine Architect / Modes Designer MODES-v2 §3, DSK L41). An added item field, so stored lists are not flagged. Rev 23 (DSK L45): built-ins path and dirt (walkable land, like floor, not buildable); 15 reserved items. wall-block stays the only catalogue spelling; wall_block is a reader alias in the format only (setup-format §2.9.3 rule 7). Existing answers drift by §2.9.3 rules 4 and 6 (appended to the effective value, nothing written).
